content:
Day 3 is here, and the 2026 Prime Day sale is still rolling. This morning, we are taking a look at the very best iPad deals live for this year’s sale celebration, joining the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 discount, a giant $150 off AirPods Pro Max, and the best deals ever on the most popular Apple Watch Series 11.

This year, the new 2026 M4 iPad Air is in the spotlight, especially the more affordable storage capacity models. We also have some rare iPad mini discounts and up to $150 off the M5 iPad Pro. Deals start from $299 on iPad this year, and you can check them all out below.

M4 iPad Air

We are now tracking the return of Amazon all-time low pricing on several of the M4 iPad Air configurations Apple released this year. While stock has been unreliable on some colors/storage options, and the more pricey deals have been somewhat stagnant, much of the most affordable end of the lineup is back to Amazon low pricing for Prime Day:

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $519 (Reg. $599) – Matching all-time low
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $610 (Reg. $699) – Matching all-time low
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB $839 (Reg. $899)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 1TB $1,019 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $699 (Reg. $799) – Matching all-time low
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $789 (Reg. $899) – Matching all-time low
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB $999 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 1TB $1,199 (Reg. $1,299)

iPad 11

Apple’s entry-level and most affordable 11-inch iPad isn’t for everyone, but it is the least expensive iPad you can buy, and even more so right now for Prime Day. This thing can make for a great road trip companion, something for the kids, or just as a great couch browser around the house.

  • iPad 11 128GB $299 (Reg. $349)
  • iPad 11 256GB $399 (Reg. $449)
  • iPad 11 256GB $597 (Reg. $649)

iPad mini

iPad mini deals have been hard to come by over the last few months. While not all models are even back in stock again, there are some solid discounts at $100 off right now if you’re looking to get in there before they all disappear and jump back up in price again.

  • iPad mini 128GB Wi-Fi + Cell $549 (Reg. $649)
  • iPad mini 256GB $499 (Reg. $599)
  • iPad mini 256GB Wi-Fi + Cell $649 (Reg. $749)
  • iPad mini 512GB $699 (Reg. $799)
  • iPad mini 512GB Wi-Fi + Cell $849 (Reg. $949)

M5 iPad Pro

Much like the iPad mini, M5 iPad Pro deals have, by and large, been a meh as of late. That said, there are price drops across the entire lineup and there are a pair of mid-range models approaching the lowest prices we have tracked to date: the 1TB 11-inch model and the 512GB 13-inch, both at $150 off – this is where the lineup shines brightest for me

  • 11-inch M5 iPad Pro 256GB $899 (Reg. $999)
  • 11-inch M5 iPad Pro 512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,199)
  • 11-inch M5 iPad Pro 1TB $1,449 (Reg. $1,599)
  • 11-inch M5 iPad Pro 2TB $1,897 (Reg. $1,999)
  • 13-inch M5 iPad Pro 256GB $1,199 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 iPad Pro 512GB $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 13-inch M5 iPad Pro 1TB $1,749 (Reg. $1,899)
  • 13-inch M5 iPad Pro 2TB $2,149 (Reg. $2,299)
